title: Dependency yanked
description: A declared package becomes unavailable during a clean rebuild.
assumptions: The build must work without a private local cache.
The scenario observes manifest metadata only and does not contact a package registry.

events.name: Upstream package yanked
events.impact: A clean install cannot resolve the dependency.

events.name: Fallback check
events.impact: The team verifies a mirror or replacement.

findings.title: Cold build path is blocked
findings.action: Verify a mirror, lock source, or tested replacement.

score.formula: 100 minus the documented dependency recovery penalties
